criteria.expectedOutcome: An isolated deployment completes evidence intake, review and transfer within an owner-approved constrained-link profile.
criteria.reason: Only local synthetic review is planned; deployment environment, link profile and measured transport are absent.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Every applied change requires an authorized human decision on its exact content and can be restored to its verified prior configuration.
criteria.reason: Prototype records synthetic proposal review and rollback instructions only; no authorized execution or rollback adapter exists.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Every operational intake, decision, change, verification and rollback action has attributable, retained and integrity-protected audit evidence.
criteria.reason: Ordered local prototype events are exportable; authenticated attribution, operational coverage, retention and integrity infrastructure are absent.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Documented open input/output interfaces interoperate with an agreed external consumer while making no connection to live Navy networks.
criteria.reason: Documented local synthetic JSON import/export and no network calls are planned; no external interoperability contract or consumer is supplied.

criteria.expectedOutcome: The delivered solution runs offline, preserves human authority, cites evidence, logs actions, synchronizes on reconnect and includes a reviewed one-page path to fleet.
criteria.reason: Local synthetic evidence, review, citations and handoff are demonstrated; reconnect transport, operational authority and reviewed fleet transition are absent.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Analyze the planning-defined synthetic baseline: LAB-A has auditEnabled=false and is the single seeded finding; LAB-B has auditEnabled=true and is benign. Explain each with exact asset/configuration and SYN-AUDIT r1 evidence; unknown values remain insufficient evidence. Preserve these citations through reviewed handoff, reject malformed input, and invalidate review after explanation edits.
After review, modifying any proposed patch content invalidates its old approval and an execution adapter rejects the stale approval.
criteria.reason: Draft and digest-bound handoff review invalidation are demonstrated, but the required execution rejection cannot be established without a lab adapter and reviewed tests.

criteria.expectedOutcome: A benign authorized lab change is applied, verified, reversed and verified again; its handoff and audit record show actual outcomes.
criteria.reason: Handoff includes proposed checks and rollback steps marked not executed / not verified; actual apply/reverse and failed rollback or partial remediation tests require the absent lab.

criteria.expectedOutcome: On an independently approved fixed corpus, report true seeded findings divided by all seeded findings and separately report false positives and unknowns.
criteria.reason: Two planning-defined synthetic examples and an unknown case are exercised; no independently approved vulnerability corpus or domain coverage target exists. No general detection rate is claimed.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Measure elapsed time from evidence availability to an independently judged correct remediation plan using an agreed correctness rubric.
criteria.reason: A proposal can be prepared locally; independent correctness rubric, analyst study and agreed timing protocol are absent.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Lab records demonstrate every change was applied only under current approval and cleanly rolled back to its prior state.
criteria.reason: Synthetic review state is shown without any execution; authorized lab application and rollback evidence are absent.

criteria.expectedOutcome: All required interactions and payload transfers complete over the agreed emulated low-bandwidth link within owner-approved limits.
criteria.reason: Offline local use is planned; no emulator, bandwidth/latency/loss profile or pass thresholds are supplied.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Audit reconciliation accounts for every required operational action, result, actor, revision and time with approved retention and integrity.
criteria.reason: Prototype exports local workflow history; operational event specification, identity, retention and integrity remain undefined.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Authorized judges evaluate Warfighting 30%; Speed to Fleet 20%; Scalability 20%; Barrier Removal 15%; Judges' Discretion 15%.
criteria.reason: Rubric is retained verbatim; scoring is reserved to human judges. No self-score substitutes for judging.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Comparable measured scenarios show shorter time from new requirement or vulnerability to independently verified remediation than the manual baseline.
criteria.reason: No execution adapter, verified remediation or comparable manual timing baseline exists; the prototype ends at a proposal.

criteria.expectedOutcome: A controlled comparison on the same network scenario shows fewer observed analyst hours than the manual baseline.
criteria.reason: No observed manual baseline, representative workload or analyst-hours study is supplied; no savings are inferred.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Commanders, system owners and data owners independently confirm that the explanation identifies impact, uncertainty, affected assets, accountable reviewer and a useful next action.
criteria.reason: Plain-language synthetic impact and next steps are included in the handoff; actionability for these audiences requires independent owner review.

criteria.expectedOutcome: Every executed change has a complete attributable audit record and a demonstrated successful reversal to its verified prior state.
criteria.reason: Proposal revisions, local events and rollback instructions are included; execution, audit assurance and actual reversibility remain unverified without the lab.
